{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue column
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for valid converted customers: converted AND completed (not refunded)
valid_converted = data[(data['converted'] == 1) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Count total valid converted customers
n_valid_converted = len(valid_converted)
print(f"Number of valid converted customers (converted=1 and status='completed'): {n_valid_converted}")

# Exclude missing age (-1)
valid_ages = valid_converted['customer_age'][valid_converted['customer_age'] != -1]
n_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
print(f"Number of valid age observations (excluding -1): {n_valid_ages}")

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of valid converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
